System: Ops-Core FAST SF Carbon

Model: A14597 Series

Configuration: OCC Dial

Description:

OPS-CORE FAST Carbon Helmet offers

protection from blunt force trauma, the FAST

Carbon has a shell weight of (size L) 1.02 lbs.

offering a lighter alternative to the FAST line of

ballistic helmets. Comes in Black, Tan, Ranger

Green, Urban Gray, or Multicam.

Modular Bungee Shroud with closed loops.

PowerPath ARC Rails.

Vented airflow allows use of headset under

helmet.
